milestone: Native mapped-token n-gram rows and coupled RAM-cache/CUDA lookup
status: qualified component; full goal remains active

api.contract: Immutable resolver layout and compressed uint32 token history. Exact uint64 row output in batch/token/ngram/head order. mapped_pad is compressed, independent of raw layout.pad_token. Source current-pad behavior preserved: pad can end a gram, then resets following context. No allocation or retained history/position state.
api.preflight: All layout, shape/overflow, buffer aliasing and every history token checked before output writes. Rejection preserves output; empty out_len is an explicit native no-op with zero output count and no data needed. Original source -0 slicing is not executed.

independent_reference.lookup_semantics: Unmodified source hash row IDs plus unchanged original Triton int4 lookup, BF16 output. Real physical checkpoint rows compacted in source ID order including repeats. No candidate runtime import.

windows: successful retry after rejected late token

coupled_lookup_per_probe.note: Raw row chunks are not whole LLM prefill/decode batches. Hash output directly feeds existing canonical native request row staging; no complete Engram consumer.

validation.qwen27: Fresh strict llama.cpp sampled-ID parity192/192; first8/8; token-count mismatch0/8.
validation.sanitizer_scope: ASAN/UBSAN C hash/model/runtime and unit/probe source instrumentation; legacy moe_cpu_kernels.o and CUDA translation units normal build. CUDA memcheck full leak check0bytes/0allocations and initcheck0errors. Unchanged row kernel bounded racecheck only; no whole-core racecheck.
validation.integrity: All original corpus payloads, independent lookup payloads, sources/probes/binaries frozen and hash-checked. Reference replay byte-identical. Modified histories/differing outputs rejected by reference tool. Four protected user binaries preserved.

not_claimed: Request-local history ownership or complete-model reset/rewind/resume qualification
BF16-to-F16 projection precision adapter, PLE/HCA or whole forward/generation admission
